fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Under Schengen rules, your passport must have an expiry date at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area.
entry.es: Según las normas de Schengen, tu pasaporte debe caducar al menos 3 meses después del día en que planees salir del espacio Schengen.
entry.quote: have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area

entry.en: Your passport must have been issued less than 10 years before the date you arrive.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe haberse expedido menos de 10 años antes de la fecha de llegada.
entry.quote: have a ‘date of issue’ less than 10 years before the date you arrive

entry.en: At Swiss border control you may also need to show a return or onward ticket.
entry.es: En el control fronterizo suizo es posible que también tengas que mostrar un billete de vuelta o de continuación.
entry.quote: show a return or onward ticket

entry.en: At Swiss border control you may need to prove you have enough money for your stay, around 100 Swiss francs a day.
entry.es: En el control fronterizo suizo puede que debas demostrar que tienes dinero suficiente para tu estancia, unos 100 francos suizos al día.
entry.quote: prove that you have enough money for your stay – around 100 Swiss francs a day

entry.en: When entering the Schengen area for short stays, you may need to register biometric details such as fingerprints and a photo.
entry.es: Al entrar en el espacio Schengen para estancias cortas, puede que debas registrar datos biométricos como huellas dactilares y una foto.
entry.quote: when you travel into the Schengen area for short stays, you may need to register your biometric details, such as fingerprints and a photo

entry.en: Personal goods worth more than Fr.5,000 in total and cash or equivalents above Fr. 10,000 have to be declared.
entry.es: Los bienes personales por más de 5.000 francos en total y el efectivo o equivalentes por encima de 10.000 francos deben declararse.
entry.quote: Personal goods worth a total of more than Fr.5,000 and cash and all cash equivalents in excess of Fr. 10,000 have to be declared.

safety.en: Serious crime is low, but petty theft reports have increased, especially in larger cities, at Geneva airport and on trains to and from Geneva.
safety.es: El crimen grave es poco frecuente, pero han aumentado las denuncias de hurtos, sobre todo en las grandes ciudades, en el aeropuerto de Ginebra y en los trenes desde y hacia Ginebra.
safety.quote: There is a low rate of serious crime in Switzerland. However, there have been increased reports of petty theft, especially in larger cities, at Geneva airport and on trains to and from Geneva.

safety.en: Terrorist attacks in Switzerland cannot be ruled out.
safety.es: No se pueden descartar atentados terroristas en Suiza.
safety.quote: Terrorist attacks in Switzerland cannot be ruled out.

safety.en: In Ticino and St Gallen it is illegal to cover your face in public, including for tourists.
safety.es: En Tesino y San Galo es ilegal cubrirse el rostro en público, también para los turistas.
safety.quote: In Ticino and St Gallen, it’s illegal to cover your face in public, including for tourists.

safety.en: Illegal drugs, including cannabis, carry severe penalties.
safety.es: Las drogas ilegales, incluido el cannabis, conllevan penas severas.
safety.quote: Illegal drugs, including cannabis, carry severe penalties.

safety.en: Off-piste skiing is very dangerous because of the risk of avalanches.
safety.es: Esquiar fuera de pista es muy peligroso por el riesgo de avalanchas.
safety.quote: Off-piste skiing is very dangerous due to the risk of avalanches.

safety.en: Causing a forest fire where there is a ban is illegal, even if unintentional, and can lead to a fine of up to 20,000 Swiss francs.
safety.es: Provocar un incendio forestal donde hay una prohibición es ilegal, incluso sin querer, y puede acarrear una multa de hasta 20.000 francos suizos.
safety.quote: Causing a forest fire in a place where there’s a ban is illegal, even if unintentional, and can lead to a fine of up to 20,000 Swiss francs.

health.en: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Switzerland, including some ski and hiking areas.
health.es: El mal de altura es un riesgo en partes de Suiza, incluidas algunas zonas de esquí y senderismo.
health.quote: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Switzerland, including the ski and hiking areas around:

health.en: Biting insects and ticks are a health risk, especially between April and October.
health.es: Los insectos que pican y las garrapatas son un riesgo para la salud, sobre todo entre abril y octubre.
health.quote: biting insects and ticks, especially between April and October

health.en: Water is drinkable everywhere, even from every tap and especially from public fountains.
health.es: El agua es potable en todas partes, incluso en cada grifo y sobre todo en las fuentes públicas.
health.quote: Water is drinkable everywhere, even out of every tap, especially so of public fountains

health.en: Treatment costs may quickly mount up, so you need travel insurance with good coverage if you cannot pay out of pocket.
health.es: Los costes de tratamiento pueden aumentar rápidamente, así que necesitas un seguro de viaje con buena cobertura si no puedes pagar de tu bolsillo.
health.quote: Treatment costs may quickly mount up, so you will require a travel insurance with a good level of coverage if you cannot pay these fees out of pocket.

help.en: The general emergency number in Switzerland is 112, covering ambulance, fire and police.
help.es: El número de emergencias general en Suiza es el 112, para ambulancia, bomberos y policía.

help.en: Separate numbers are ambulance 144, fire 118 and police 117.
help.es: Los números separados son ambulancia 144, bomberos 118 y policía 117.
help.quote: Telephone: 112 (ambulance, fire, police) Ambulance: 144 Fire: 118 Police: 117

help.en: The emergency number is 112, and operators generally speak English.
help.es: El número de emergencias es el 112 y los operadores suelen hablar inglés.
help.quote: The emergency phone number in Switzerland is 112, and operators generally speak English.

getting_in.en: Major international airports are in Zurich, Geneva and Basel, with smaller airports in Lugano and Bern.
getting_in.es: Los principales aeropuertos internacionales están en Zúrich, Ginebra y Basilea, con aeropuertos menores en Lugano y Berna.
getting_in.quote: Major international airports are in Zurich ZRH IATA, Geneva GVA IATA and Basel (for the Swiss part: BSL IATA), with smaller airports in Lugano LUG IATA and Bern BRN IATA.

getting_in.en: Basel airport also serves neighbouring Mulhouse and Freiburg and has three different IATA codes.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto de Basilea también sirve a las vecinas Mulhouse y Friburgo y tiene tres códigos IATA distintos.
getting_in.quote: Basel airport is a peculiar case, as it also serves neighbouring Mulhouse and Freiburg and has three different IATA codes

getting_in.en: The TGV Lyria high-speed train runs several times daily from and to Paris, Dijon, Lyon and other French cities.
getting_in.es: El tren de alta velocidad TGV Lyria circula varias veces al día desde y hacia París, Dijon, Lyon y otras ciudades francesas.
getting_in.quote: The TGV Lyria (Train à grande vitesse, French/Swiss high-speed railway connection), with several trains daily from/to Paris, Dijon, Lyon

getting_in.en: Hourly EuroCity trains run to and from Milan, with connections to all parts of Italy.
getting_in.es: Hay trenes EuroCity cada hora desde y hacia Milán, con conexiones a todo Italia.
getting_in.quote: Hourly EuroCity (EC) trains to/from Milan with connections to all parts of Italy.

getting_in.en: Flixbus is prohibited by law from carrying passengers domestically in Switzerland, so domestic routes cannot be booked.
getting_in.es: Flixbus tiene prohibido por ley transportar pasajeros dentro de Suiza, por lo que no se pueden reservar trayectos nacionales.
getting_in.quote: Flixbus is prohibited by law from carrying passengers domestically in Switzerland and you cannot book domestic routes with them

getting_around.en: There is generally at least one train or bus per hour on every route, and on many routes every 30 or even 15 minutes.
getting_around.es: En general hay al menos un tren o autobús por hora en cada ruta, y en muchas cada 30 o incluso 15 minutos.
getting_around.quote: In general there's at least one train or bus per hour on every route; on many routes trains and buses run every 30 or even 15 minutes.

getting_around.en: Where no train or city transit is available, the PostAuto bus network gets you there.
getting_around.es: Donde no hay tren ni transporte urbano, la red de autobuses PostAuto te lleva hasta allí.
getting_around.quote: Even if there is no train or city transit available, the comprehensive PostAuto/CarPostale/AutoPostale network gets you there.

getting_around.en: Discount options and ticket types can be bewildering, from half-fare cards to multi-day, multi-use tickets.
getting_around.es: Las opciones de descuento y los tipos de billete pueden resultar abrumadores, desde tarjetas de media tarifa hasta billetes multiuso de varios días.
getting_around.quote: The discount options and variety of tickets can be bewildering, from half-fare cards to multi-day, multi-use tickets

getting_around.en: Usual speed limits are 120 km/h on motorways, 100 on expressways, 80 on main roads outside towns and in tunnels, and 50 in villages and towns.
getting_around.es: Los límites habituales son 120 km/h en autopistas, 100 en autovías, 80 en carreteras principales fuera de poblado y en túneles, y 50 en pueblos y ciudades.
getting_around.quote: The usual speed limits in Switzerland are 120 km/h (75 mph) on motorways, 100 km/h on expressways, 80 km/h (50 mph) on main roads outside towns and in tunnels, and 50 km/h (31 mph) limit in villages and towns.

getting_around.en: Most drivers need a vignette costing Fr. 40, a sticker or digital registration valid for the entire year on motorways and expressways.
getting_around.es: La mayoría de conductores necesita una viñeta de 40 francos, adhesivo o registro digital, válida todo el año en autopistas y autovías.
getting_around.quote: Most drivers will need to buy a vignette, a physical sticker or digital registration which costs Fr. 40 that allows you to use motorways and expressways as much as you like for the entire year.

getting_around.en: Using any app with a speed camera warning function, including Google Maps or Waze features, is illegal.
getting_around.es: Usar cualquier aplicación con aviso de radares, incluidas las funciones de Google Maps o Waze, es ilegal.
getting_around.quote: Using any app with a 'speed camera warning' function (including Google Maps/Waze features) is illegal.

money.en: The currency is the Swiss franc, called Franken, franc or franco depending on the language area.
money.es: La moneda es el franco suizo, llamado Franken, franc o franco según la zona lingüística.
money.quote: Switzerland's currency is the Swiss franc (or Franken, or franc, or franco, depending on which language area you are in)

money.en: Card payments are common and you can easily travel for days without needing cash.
money.es: Los pagos con tarjeta son habituales y se puede viajar varios días sin necesitar efectivo.
money.quote: credit/debit card payments are common and you can easily travel for days without ever needing cash

money.en: All ATMs accept foreign cards, so getting cash should not be a problem.
money.es: Todos los cajeros aceptan tarjetas extranjeras, así que conseguir efectivo no debería ser un problema.
money.quote: all ATMs accept foreign cards, so getting cash should not be a problem.

money.en: Some places, such as supermarkets, restaurants, hotels and railways, accept euro bills but not coins.
money.es: Algunos lugares, como supermercados, restaurantes, hoteles y ferrocarriles, aceptan billetes en euros pero no monedas.
money.quote: some places – such as supermarkets, restaurants, tourist attraction ticket counters, hotels and the railways or ticket machines – accept euro bills (but no coins)

money.en: By law a service charge is included in the bill, but if satisfied you may round up the bill, especially in restaurants.
money.es: Por ley el servicio está incluido en la cuenta, pero si estás satisfecho puedes redondearla al alza, sobre todo en restaurantes.
money.quote: By law, a service charge is included in the bill. Nevertheless, if you feel satisfied, especially in restaurants, you may round up the bill

money.en: Foreign visitors can claim a VAT refund if they spend at least CHF 300 in one transaction and leave Switzerland with the items within 30 days.
money.es: Los visitantes extranjeros pueden reclamar la devolución del IVA si gastan al menos 300 CHF en una sola compra y salen de Suiza con los artículos en 30 días.
money.quote: Foreign visitors can claim a refund on the VAT if they spend at least CHF 300.00 (after tax) in a single transaction, and depart Switzerland with the items within 30 days of making the purchase.

etiquette.en: Sunday is considered a rest day in Switzerland and many shops and businesses close.
etiquette.es: El domingo se considera día de descanso en Suiza y muchas tiendas y negocios cierran.
etiquette.quote: Sunday is considered a "rest day" in Switzerland. On Sundays, many shops and businesses close down.

etiquette.en: Punctuality matters: being more than one minute late is frowned upon.
etiquette.es: La puntualidad importa: llegar más de un minuto tarde está mal visto.
etiquette.quote: Be punctual. That means no more than one minute late, if that!

etiquette.en: It is both impolite and illegal to record or photograph someone without their permission.
etiquette.es: Es descortés e ilegal grabar o fotografiar a alguien sin su permiso.
etiquette.quote: it is both impolite and illegal to record or take pictures of someone unless they have given you permission.

etiquette.en: English is widely spoken, but any attempt to speak the local language is appreciated.
etiquette.es: Se habla mucho inglés, pero se aprecia cualquier intento de hablar el idioma local.
etiquette.quote: English is widely spoken in Switzerland, but any attempt to speak the local language is appreciated, even if you are replied to in English.

etiquette.en: In French and German speaking parts, friends kiss on the cheek three times (left, right, left), a common custom when being introduced.
etiquette.es: En las zonas francófonas y germanófonas los amigos se besan en la mejilla tres veces (izquierda, derecha, izquierda), costumbre habitual al presentarse.
etiquette.quote: Friends kiss each other on the cheek three times – left, right, left – and it is a common custom when being introduced to someone in the French and German speaking parts.

etiquette.en: In some cantons there are fines for littering, about Fr. 40 to 80.
etiquette.es: En algunos cantones hay multas por tirar basura, de unos 40 a 80 francos.
etiquette.quote: In some cantons, there are fines for littering (about Fr. 40 to 80)

connectivity.en: A copy of an identity card or passport is required to buy or activate a local SIM card.
connectivity.es: Se requiere una copia del documento de identidad o pasaporte para comprar o activar una tarjeta SIM local.
connectivity.quote: Due to a law introduced in 2018, a copy of an identity card/passport is required for buying or activating a local SIM card.

connectivity.en: Mobile network coverage is close to 100% by area, even in mountainous, unpopulated areas.
connectivity.es: La cobertura móvil es cercana al 100 % del territorio, incluso en zonas montañosas y despobladas.
connectivity.quote: Mobile network coverage is close to 100% by area, even in the mountainous, non-populated areas.

connectivity.en: Prepaid cards usually cost around Fr. 10-40 and are sold in Swisscom, Salt or Sunrise shops in most cities.
connectivity.es: Las tarjetas de prepago suelen costar unos 10-40 francos y se venden en tiendas de Swisscom, Salt o Sunrise en la mayoría de ciudades.
connectivity.quote: they usually cost around Fr. 10-40 and are obtainable in the shops of the mobile service providers Swisscom, Salt or Sunrise in most cities

connectivity.en: SBB offers free Wi-Fi in some stations, usually bigger ones, but you must verify your identity by SMS.
connectivity.es: SBB ofrece wifi gratis en algunas estaciones, normalmente las mayores, pero debes verificar tu identidad por SMS.
connectivity.quote: The Swiss Federal Railways (SBB CFF FFS) are now offering free Wi-Fi in some of their stations (usually the bigger ones) but you will need to verify your identity by receiving an SMS on your phone
